issues: County commissioners are district seats (1, 3, 4); District 2 was not on the 2026 ballot.
Official general assessor is listed as REP RIGGS, while the official primary nominee is TARA M BERG.
notes: Official scanned summaries (primary 08/20/2026 10:43 AM America/Denver; general abstract 11/05/2026 9:37 AM America/Denver), visually verified at 300 dpi. County commissioners are elected by district (Districts 1, 3, and 4 on the 2026 ballot; District 2 was not up). The general abstract prints surname only (with a party prefix); primary ballot names are used on primary rows and noted on merged general rows. Write-In Totals are used once; the matching Not Assigned line is not added again. Named DEM write-in breakdowns are not listed as separate candidates. REP assessor nominee on the official primary is TARA M BERG; the official general abstract lists REP RIGGS for assessor. 2026-11-14 recheck: the general abstract posted on the county site (11/05 and 11/09 copies) is identical to the one keyed; the "2026 General Official Precinct Summary.pdf" link opens a 2024 test-deck report (misposted) and was not used.
